title: English Practice Quiz 0936
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Personal protective equipment is commonly abbreviated as ___.
questions.explanation: PPE stands for personal protective equipment.

questions.question: Safety footwear is designed to help protect the ___.
questions.explanation: Protective footwear can reduce foot injuries from specific hazards.

questions.question: A fire extinguisher should be used only by someone who ___.
options: is trained and can do so safely
questions.explanation: Training and safe conditions are essential before attempting to use an extinguisher.

questions.question: A damaged electrical cable should be ___.
options: taken out of use and reported
repaired with ordinary tape while powered
questions.explanation: Damaged cables can cause electric shock or fire and must be reported.

questions.question: A high-visibility vest helps workers to be ___.
questions.explanation: High-visibility clothing improves visibility in suitable environments.

questions.question: Eye protection is especially important when a task may produce ___.
questions.explanation: Safety glasses or goggles protect against relevant eye hazards.

questions.question: A safety sign showing a crossed-out cigarette means ___.
options: the sign is a fire exit
questions.explanation: The symbol indicates a no-smoking restriction.

questions.question: Before using lifting equipment, an employee should check that it is ___.
questions.explanation: Equipment must be appropriate and in safe working condition.

questions.question: A spill kit is used to ___.
options: manage certain spills safely according to procedure
questions.explanation: Spill kits contain materials for handling specified spills.

questions.question: Safety equipment inspections should be ___.
options: recorded according to the inspection schedule
questions.explanation: Records help demonstrate that checks were completed.
